name: PGA National Resort

address.street: 400 Avenue of the Champions Palm Beach Gardens

insider_take: This championship golf paradise sits on 2,340 lush acres where legends are made and luxury meets athletic excellence.
whats_special: Home to the famous "Bear Trap" - three of the most challenging finishing holes in professional golf, designed by Jack Nicklaus. The resort features five championship courses and hosts the PGA Tour's Honda Classic annually. The signature Waters of the World spa offers mineral pools inspired by the Dead Sea, Mediterranean, and other global destinations.
pro_tip: Book tee times early for the Champion Course during Honda Classic season (February-March) when you can play the same holes that challenge tour pros, including the notorious island green at hole 15.
dont_miss: The David Leadbetter Golf Academy for personalized instruction, crocodile spotting at the on-property lakes, and sunset cocktails at 19th Hole Bar overlooking the Champion Course where Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy have made golf history.
pros: Championship golf courses including famous PGA tournament venues
Extensive spa and wellness facilities with mineral pools
Multiple dining options and resort amenities
Prime Palm Beach Gardens location with easy access to attractions
cons: Golf-focused resort may not appeal to non-golfers
Premium pricing for resort amenities and activities
